decision_rule.DENSE_PROXIES: Reported per variant beside the pooled score, because a 625-row pooled SLU delta is at the measurement floor and a dense proxy is not: entity FALSE POSITIVES and FALSE NEGATIVES by slot TYPE, the empty-gold-row emission rate, intent exactness, and -- from the sealed Perception receipts, model-free -- the coverage rate (gold intent present in the row's own candidate list). Coverage is the quantity VAR1-PER-K16C5 exists to move and is read directly, not inferred from the pooled score.
decision_rule.EFFICIENCY_REGARDLESS: Every efficiency deliverable is reported whatever the table says. VAR1-EX-K10 in particular is expected to cost FEWER prefilled tokens per row than VAR1-PLAN, and a variant that holds the score at a lower token cost is a finding in its own right.
decision_rule.FRONTIER: Owner decision 75: the frontier row (official SLU-F1 delta x prefilled tokens per row x GPU hours per 625 rows) is reported for every variant beside the registered rows. The denominator is 625 here, not 1,080 or 1,000: a frontier row from another roster is rescaled or labelled, never silently placed beside.
decision_rule.GROUP_RELATIVE_ADVANTAGE: PRIMARY DELIVERABLE. For every runtime-observable state key -- predicted scenario (the majority scenario of the row's own Perception candidates), candidate count, channel (headset / far-field) and audio-duration band -- the per-row scores of the K variants plus VAR1-PLAN are grouped, and each variant's advantage is its score minus the group mean over the variants ON THAT ROW. That is the group-relative advantage a training-free RL policy would be learned from, and computing it is the whole point of flying the variants paired on one roster. It is reported with its per-state sample size and is never read as an effect at a state with fewer than twenty rows.
decision_rule.OWN_NULL_FIRST: THE ORDER IS PART OF THE REGISTRATION. h_SLU and h_intent are the CI95 half-widths VAR1-PLAN against VAR1-PLANR produces on THIS roster, with the same estimator, clustering, seed and draws as every variant contrast. The own-null read SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-VAR1-OWN-NULL-V1 is completed and its margin table SEALED before any variant contrast stage is read, and the margins are never adjusted after a variant's numbers are seen. The TRAIN Fold A margins (h_SLU 1.2485 / h_intent 0.9943) and the DEV-2000-ADDED margins (1.2525 / 1.1520) are CONTEXT ONLY: a margin is a property of a roster, never of a mechanism, and R01C is a different roster of a different size.
decision_rule.PER_STRATUM: Owner decision 17: a per-scenario table in BOTH weightings, natural mixture and equal-stratum. R01C's roster receipt carries a per-item stratum (18 scenarios, 26-42 rows each), so unlike DEV-2000-ADDED a GOLD per-scenario table IS derivable here offline, from the roster receipt alone and with no gold at runtime. It is reported for every variant.
decision_rule.PER_VARIANT_READING: For each variant v: delta(v) = v minus VAR1-PLAN on the same 625 rows, paired by row, in percentage points, for the official pooled SLU micro F1 (primary) and the intent (joint scenario+action) accuracy (guard). Each delta is reported with its CI90 and CI95 from the row-cluster bootstrap, beside h_SLU and h_intent from the own null. A variant is called SEPARATED FROM THE NULL when its CI95 excludes zero AND its point estimate is outside +-h on that metric; anything else is INSIDE THE NULL. That is a reading of a construction rollout, NOT an admission: the words ADMITTED and HARMFUL are not used of a VAR-1 cell.
decision_rule.REPLICATION_AND_TRANSFER: NOTHING SELECTED HERE IS A RESULT. A variant that separates from the null on R01C is a CANDIDATE, and the next step is a re-read of that one variant on TRAIN Fold A against the sealed PLAN comparator at Fold A's own null, and then on DEV-2000-ADDED at its own null -- the CELL-3 lesson, where a store selected on Fold A did not transfer to a fresh roster. Selecting on construction rows and claiming on them is the error this family is designed not to repeat.
decision_rule.STATUS_IS_DESCRIPTIVE: THIS FAMILY RETURNS NO ADMISSION VERDICT. It is a construction-variant ROLLOUT on a construction roster: its output is a table, not a decision. No ADMITTED / NEUTRAL / HARMFUL label is attached to any VAR-1 cell, no module is admitted, no store is released, nothing is locked and the v2.0 lock is untouched. The paired read driver writes status DESCRIPTIVE and the coordinator does not convert it.
decision_rule.comparator: cell VAR1-PLAN (SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-VAR1-PLAN-R01C-V1), flown in this same family. It is FLOWN rather than imported because no plan-form arm has ever been sealed on R01C: cell ROLL-1 flew the five-sample grouped-Solver policy (phase-native-candidates-review-revise-samples5-v1), not the locked single-sample plan, and greedy decoding is not bit-reproducible across batch compositions, so a comparator from another roster would import a margin this family cannot measure.

diagnostics_required: THE VARIANT TABLE, the item this family exists for: for each of the four variants and for VAR1-PLANR, the paired delta against VAR1-PLAN on official pooled SLU-F1 and intent, with CI90, CI95, saves / harms / ties and the exact McNemar sign-test p, beside h_SLU and h_intent from the own null.

GROUP-RELATIVE ADVANTAGE PER RUNTIME-OBSERVABLE STATE: for each state key (predicted majority candidate scenario, candidate count, channel, audio-duration band), each variant's per-row score minus the per-row mean over the variants, aggregated, with the per-state n. Never read as an effect below n = 20.

GOLD PER-SCENARIO TABLES per variant, in both the natural mixture and the equal-stratum weighting, over the 18 R01C strata (26-42 rows each) from the roster receipt's per-item stratum. This is available here and was NOT available on DEV-2000-ADDED.

ENTITY FP / FN BY SLOT TYPE per variant, with the empty-gold-row emission rate: the bad-case classes the exemplar knobs are aimed at (entity FN about 31.5 %, date omission dominant; entity FP about 28.8 %, 184 of 414 empty-gold rows emitting).

PERCEPTION COVERAGE per variant from the sealed Perception receipts, model-free: the rate at which the gold intent appears in the row's own projected candidate list, the candidate count distribution, and the distinctness of the candidate ids. This is the quantity VAR1-PER-K16C5 exists to move; reading it from the pooled score instead would be reading a 2 pp lever through a 1.3 pp floor.

SUPPLY REALISATION per variant: the realised number of exemplar values supplied per row (the EX knobs) and of intent cards seeded per row (the PER knob), from the flight's own phase-supply receipts, beside the offline dry-run projection. VAR1-EX-DIV in particular has a DATA-DEPENDENT supply size -- c = 4 per intent target caps a concentrated neighbourhood and leaves a diverse one untouched -- and the realised distribution is a finding.
PER-CHANNEL table (67 headset, 558 far-field) from the roster's own headset field, descriptive and unclustered.

COST per variant: contacts, contacts per row, prefilled and cached tokens per row, GPU hours per 625 rows, and the frontier row. VAR1-EX-K10 is expected to be cheaper than VAR1-PLAN and VAR1-EX-K30 / VAR1-PER-K16C5 dearer; the exchange rate between tokens and score is part of what a construction rollout measures.

E20 COMPACTION per phase and per variant: rows compacted, at which phase and by how much. Zero is expected on VAR1-PLAN / PLANR / EX-K10 / EX-DIV; a non-zero count on VAR1-EX-K30 or VAR1-PER-K16C5 is a caveat on that variant's token basis and is reported, not hidden. An ABSTENTION caused by compaction is a failure, not a caveat.

DISPOSITIONS per variant: finite_completion rows (item E13), react_exhaustion rows (item E22), planner illegal-action rows, parse failures, and the delivery-normaliser receipt count. A variant whose disposition profile differs from VAR1-PLAN's has changed the episode's behaviour and not only its supply.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster, role-graph, prompt, knowledge, geometry or cap change. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration for this run, which needs BOTH a new generation attempt id AND a new native_contact_fit.attempt_id (the CELL-1 lesson: the fit gate binds the baseline's fit identity and refuses one that already carries evidence); a second failure closes this flight and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run before another mechanism is admitted. RESUME-RECOVERY CLAUSE (owner decision 22 of 2026-09-18): if the abort is an INFRASTRUCTURE failure with code and request bytes unchanged, the one recovery takes the resume-recovery form of harness item E10 -- the same run id, a fresh attempt id, a resume_from declaration naming the predecessor attempt and its trace SHA-256, every COMPLETE row kept without selection under invariant I7r, every partial or unstarted row re-flown in full, no change to the question, roster, comparator, decision rule or caps, and the run-cumulative budget re-checked; otherwise the one recovery is a full re-fly. A partial manifest is never scored and never read. One experiment is in flight at a time: a failure in any VAR-1 cell stops the whole family's chain, and the remaining variants do not open.

fuse_semantics.saea-fuse-associated-values-v1 (intent-b: the first m ranked facets are admitted by the cosine threshold; they are traversed in rank order taking at most c NEW values per facet, and the traversal stops at top_l values overall. The released intent-boundaries store has 60 facets and 60 values, one per intent, so c=1 with m=top_l=k gives exactly k intent cards. k 8 -> 16 therefore doubles the Perception node's card block; the store's cards average 702 characters (max 895), so this is the single largest text change in the family and the reason VAR1-PER-K16C5 is the one form that carries a smoke.
fuse_semantics.saea-fuse-supplyfilter-v1 (train-exempla: m is the top-m ranked-facet window the percept threshold tau is applied inside; the admitted values are grouped by their task_target (for this store an SLURP intent id, 59 distinct over 8,554 values); top_l bounds how many TARGETS are served; c bounds how many values per served target. At k=m=c=top_l=20 the route is twenty in and twenty out, because each exemplar value associates with exactly one content facet. Dropping c to 4 therefore caps the supply at four demonstrations PER INTENT and shrinks the block on intent-concentrated neighbourhoods -- that is precisely what VAR1-EX-DIV measures, and the realised per-row counts are a deliverable, not an assumption.

cell2_measured_bound_for_reference.source: docs/readiness/2026-09-24-slurp-stage3-delta-cell-r02-v1/registered-facts-v1.json, measured on TRAIN Fold A for the locked plan PLUS the stage3-deltas-v2 store

prompt_fit.decision: EXPECTED: ALLOW or COMPACT_REQUIRED on every phase of every cell, and NEVER REFUSE. Arithmetic, registered before contact. (1) VAR1-EX-K30's widest SUPPLIED Solver content on the four offline rows is 28,728 characters against VAR1-PLAN's 27,394 -- 1,334 more, at most 534 tokens at 2.5 characters per token. CELL-2's MEASURED Solver bound on TRAIN Fold A was 21,821 required-window tokens WITH a stage3-deltas block VAR-1 does not carry; adding the bound above to that upper reference gives at most 22,355 against the 24,576-token slot, so REFUSE is arithmetically excluded and COMPACT_REQUIRED is the expectation. (2) VAR1-PER-K16C5's widest supplied Perception content is 11,570 characters against VAR1-PLAN's 5,862 -- 5,708 more, at most 2,284 tokens on the same basis. CELL-2's measured Perception bound was 19,992 with an unconditional delta block VAR-1 does not carry, giving at most 22,276, again inside the slot. (3) VAR1-PER-K16C5's Solver block grows too, by a smaller amount: its widest supplied Solver content is 28,999 characters, 1,605 more than VAR1-PLAN's, at most 642 tokens, for at most 22,463. That is the five-candidate round robin filling the UNCHANGED 28-value / 16-per-candidate slot-contract budget differently, not a larger budget: max_total_values and max_values_per_candidate are not moved. (4) VAR1-EX-K10 and VAR1-EX-DIV can only SHRINK the Solver block, and the offline measurement confirms it. A COMPACT_REQUIRED is recorded and the flight proceeds; a REFUSE triggers the registered fallback and that cell alone does not open.
prompt_fit.fallback_if_refused: FAIL-CLOSED AND REGISTERED BEFORE CONTACT: if the coordinator's check reports REFUSE (not COMPACT_REQUIRED) on VAR1-EX-K30's Solver, that cell DOES NOT OPEN. It is re-registered at k = 26 with fuse_coverage 26/26/26, a NEW run id, a NEW generation attempt id and a NEW native_contact_fit attempt id, and the k = 30 identity is retired unused. The same rule applies to VAR1-PER-K16C5 at k = 12 with coverage 1/12/12. No other cell is touched, and no margin or decision rule moves.
prompt_fit.rule: rails.context_budget: required_window_tokens = rendered text tokens + speech tokens + the registered special-token reserve + the 512-token completion ceiling. ALLOW when required <= slot - reserve = 21,504; COMPACT_REQUIRED when required <= slot = 24,576, which core.flight.runtime RECORDS and proceeds on under native_episode.context_fit_policy = compact-or-abstain (harness item E20, owner decision 45); REFUSE above the slot, which aborts.
prompt_fit.the_authority_in_flight: core.preparation_fit.build_native_contact_fit_gate fits every realised immutable request against the resident tokenizer, contact by contact.
prompt_fit.what_the_characters_say: The knowledge a store decides for a node does NOT travel in the rendered instruction -- it reaches the node as typed content blocks through the acquire transition, and every VAR-1 form's rendered instruction is the same 1,129 characters at the Solver and 960 at Perception. So the quantity that actually moves is measured directly: the SUPPLIED CONTENT CHARACTERS per node per row, summed from the released snapshots over the value ids the offline walk selected on the same four R01C rows. Converting a character DIFFERENCE to a token bound at the deliberately pessimistic 2.5 characters per token over-states the tokens the extra block costs, so a fit conclusion drawn that way is conservative. The absolute required-window token count is NOT derived this way and is left to the tokenizer.

quality_gate: no task-quality read of any cell before its complete sealed manifest, its exact ordered 625 outputs, its native phase summary and its single successful complete official TRAIN score all exist. THE OWN NULL IS READ FIRST: no variant's contrast stage is read until SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-VAR1-OWN-NULL-V1 has sealed its margin table. The efficiency reads may proceed from the sealed receipts, trace and server log as soon as a manifest seals, because they touch no answer, reference or quality field.

resampling.interval_form: percentile pairs of the same retained replicate sequence
resampling.pairing_note: both sides of every contrast are decoded runs, so the paired interval carries real decoding noise; the roster's own null is the calibration for exactly that, which is why VAR1-PLANR flies before any variant.
resampling.primary: paired row-cluster bootstrap over the roster's utterance ids. R01C carries 625 DISTINCT utterance ids, so the cluster is the row and this is the paired per-row bootstrap; the cluster key is declared anyway so the estimator is the same function every other SLURP read uses.
resampling.speaker_clustering: NOT DERIVABLE: the R01C roster receipt carries no per-item speaker field. Stated in the verdict rather than worked around.
tables: equal-stratum weighting over the gold scenario

resume_recovery_clause: owner decision 22 of 2026-09-18. If an attempt dies of an INFRASTRUCTURE failure with code and request bytes unchanged, the one allowed recovery takes the resume-recovery form of harness item E10: the same run id, a fresh attempt id AND a fresh native_contact_fit.attempt_id, a resume_from declaration naming the predecessor attempt and its trace SHA-256, every COMPLETE row kept without selection under invariant I7r, every partial or unstarted row re-flown in full, no change to the question, roster, comparator, decision rule or caps, and the run-cumulative budget re-checked.
